cohort: 11 pregnant women with confirmed Influenza A (H1N1) infection
finding: This retrospective study found that pregnant women with H1N1 infection were at higher risk of pneumonia and death and that prolonged time to initiation of oseltamivir and higher body mass index were statistically significantly associated with fatal outcome.
mod_finding: None of the women who recovered from H1N1 infection experienced preterm delivery or abortion.
